quote: specifically intended to treat potentially life-threatening fungal infections
note: Label lists life-threatening fungal infections; edge is a near parent of the listed mycoses.

quote: to reduce risk of stroke and systemic embolism in nonvalvular atrial fibrillation
note: Heart conditions (AF, CAD, congenital heart disease) appear only as patient populations; the treated targets are thromboembolic events.

quote: indicated for the treatment of patients with severe aplastic anemia who have had an insufficient response to immunosuppressive therapy
note: Severe aplastic anemia explicitly indicated.

quote: indicated for prophylaxis to prevent attacks of hereditary angioedema (HAE)
note: HAE attack prophylaxis is an explicit indication.
Topotecan text covers SCLC and cervical carcinoma only; ovarian cancer not mentioned.
Diabetic kidney disease appears only in generic boilerplate about other antihypertensives; not a valsartan indication.

quote: indicated for the radical cure (prevention of relapse) of vivax malaria
note: Vivax malaria explicitly indicated.

quote: persistent or chronic cough such as occurs with smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis or emphysema
note: Bronchitis appears only in the ask-a-doctor warning; indications are cough/bronchial irritation with a cold.

quote: Sympathetic ophthalmia, temporal arteritis, uveitis and ocular inflammatory conditions unresponsive to topical corticosteroids
note: Uveitis is a listed ophthalmic indication.

quote: Proteus mirabilis Pseudomonas aeruginosa CORNEAL ULCERS
note: Ophthalmic label lists CORNEAL ULCERS as a treated condition.

quote: Acute and subacute bursitis
note: Bursitis is a listed rheumatic indication.

quote: should not be used to treat type 1 diabetes or diabetic ketoacidosis, as it would not be effective in these settings
note: Type 1 diabetes explicitly excluded.

quote: indicated for the management of pain severe enough to require an opioid analgesic
note: Chest pain is a subtype of the broadly indicated severe pain.

quote: indicated for the management of severe and persistent pain that requires an extended treatment period with a daily opioid analgesic
note: Facial pain is a subtype of the broadly indicated severe persistent pain.

quote: indicated for the reduction of symptoms of intermittent claudication
note: Intermittent claudication explicitly indicated.

quote: radioactive diagnostic agent indicated as an adjunct to other diagnostic evaluations
note: Diagnostic imaging agent; DLB is the population being evaluated, not treated.

quote: acute gouty arthritis, acute and subacute bursitis, acute nonspecific tenosynovitis
note: Subacute bursitis explicitly listed.
Only use is prevention of dental cavities; dentin sensitivity not mentioned.

quote: Efficacy has been shown in a PAH population including idiopathic and heritable PAH
note: EMA indication is PAH; heritable PAH is a subtype explicitly named.

quote: treatment or prevention of bronchospasm in adults, adolescents, and children 6 years of age and older with reversible obstructive airway disease
note: Asthma is a form of the indicated reversible obstructive airway disease.
Anger is not an indication; only irritable mood/aggressiveness described as mania symptoms.
Only use is moisturizing dry nasal passages; salicylate poisoning not mentioned.

quote: symptoms of hay fever or other upper respiratory allergies: runny nose sneezing nasal congestion
note: Hay fever (allergic rhinitis) symptom relief is an indicated use.

quote: indicated for intravenous administration to infants for treatment of dehydration, acidosis, diarrhea, and burns
note: Multi-electrolyte fluid therapy is supportive care; burns are the underlying illness, not the phosphate target.

quote: indicated for the treatment of adult patients with insomnia, characterized by difficulties with sleep onset and/or sleep maintenance
note: Paradoxical insomnia is a subtype of indicated insomnia.

quote: advanced mycosis fungoides (cutaneous T cell lymphoma)
note: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma explicitly named.

quote: For the treatment of most athlete's foot (tinea pedis), jock itch (tinea cruris), ringworm (tinea corporis)
note: Tinea infections explicitly indicated.

quote: indicated for the treatment of patients with multiple myeloma and patients with documented bone metastases from solid tumors
note: Multiple myeloma named in the indication.

quote: reduce the risk of acute urinary retention (AUR)
note: Risk reduction (prevention) of AUR is an explicit indication goal.

quote: may be used in patients with chronic open-angle glaucoma and intraocular hypertension
note: Open-angle glaucoma indicated; glaucoma is a near parent.

quote: found useful in the treatment of acute non-lymphocytic leukemia and the blast phase of chronic myelocytic leukemia
note: Blast-phase CML named in indications; CML is a near parent.

quote: to reduce LDL-C in adults with hypercholesterolemia, including heterozygous familial hypercholesterolemia (HeFH)
note: HeFH explicitly named on the bempedoic acid (NEXLETOL) label.

quote: indicated for the treatment of chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps in adult patients 18 years of age and older
note: Nasal polyps explicitly treated.

quote: atorvastatin is indicated to: Reduce the risk of myocardial infarction
note: MI risk reduction is an explicit atorvastatin indication.

quote: treatment of refractory hypotension in adults with septic or other distributive shock
note: Treating the defining hypotension of distributive shock is shock management.

quote: indicated in adult patients for treatment of urinary tract infections caused by Escherichia coli
note: Bacterial UTI explicitly indicated.

quote: for patients with HES and/or CEL who are FIP1L1-PDGFRα fusion kinase negative or unknown
note: HES indicated including fusion-negative/unknown (idiopathic) cases.

quote: indicated for the treatment of panic disorder, with or without agoraphobia
note: Label treats panic disorder; panic attack is its manifestation.

quote: indicated for the treatment of patients with high-risk early-stage triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC)
note: TNBC explicitly indicated.

quote: Relief of the signs and symptoms of osteoarthritis (OA)
note: OA symptom management counts per rubric.

quote: indicated for prophylaxis to prevent attacks of hereditary angioedema (HAE)
note: HAE type 3 is a subtype of indicated HAE.

quote: control of ventricular rate at rest and during stress in patients with chronic atrial flutter and/or atrial fibrillation
note: Rate control of atrial flutter is management of the arrhythmia.

quote: Gastrointestinal Infections caused by Salmonella typhi (typhoid fever)
note: Typhoid fever explicitly named.

quote: stimulate respiration in patients with drug-induced postanesthesia respiratory depression or apnea
note: Postanesthesia apnea indicated; apnea is a near parent.

quote: Hypogonadotropic hypogonadism (congenital or acquired)
note: Congenital HH indicated; HH12 is a subtype.
